title: Saying what you do

grammar.title: Five power-words that do everything
grammar.body: You don't need to conjugate much to get by. Master these fixed forms and add a noun or an infinitive: **quiero** (I want), **necesito** (I need), **tengo** (I have), **hay** (there is/are), **voy a** (I'm going to). 'Quiero un café', 'voy a comer'.

canDo: Say what you want, need, and have
Ask if something exists or is available
Say what you're going to do next

items.note: Add a verb: voy a comer, voy a pagar.
'¿puedo pagar con tarjeta?' = may I pay by card?
Infinitives — the form you use after 'voy a' and 'quiero'.
